docs.title: 2026 年 AI 代理和 MCP 服务器的最佳身份验证平台
docs.text:
Best Authentication Platforms for AI Agents and MCP Servers in 2026 摘要：随着 MCP 每月 SDK 下载量超过 9700 万次，并且 AI 代理进入生产工作流程，身份验证已成为基础设施决策团队面临的最关键问题。本指南对八个领先平台进行了排名：WorkOS、Stytch、Auth0 by Okta、Composio、Nango、Arcade、TrueFoundry 和 Cloudf

原文：As MCP crosses 97 million monthly SDK downloads and AI agents move into production workflows, authentication has become the most critical infrastructure decision teams face. This guide ranks the eight leading platforms — WorkOS, Stytch, Auth0 by Okta, Composio, Nango, Arcade, TrueFoundry, and Cloudf 来源：MarkTechPost

docs.title: WorkOS 发布 auth.md：基于 OAuth 标准构建的开放代理注册协议
docs.text:
WorkOS Releases auth.md: An Open Agent Registration Protocol Built on OAuth Standards 摘要：大多数网络应用程序仍然没有结构化的方式供人工智能代理注册。 auth.md 提出了一个修复方案：应用程序在其域中发布一个 Markdown 文件，告诉代理支持哪些注册流程、要请求哪些范围以及如何获取与真实用户关联的凭据 - 无需人工填写

原文：Most web applications still have no structured way for an AI agent to register. auth.md proposes a fix: a Markdown file apps publish at their domain that tells agents which registration flows are supported, which scopes to request, and how to get credentials tied to a real user — without a human fil 来源：MarkTechPost

原文：In this tutorial, we implement the Langfuse (an open-source LLM engineering platform) pipeline for tracing, prompt management, scoring, datasets, and experiments. We build a complete workflow that works with either a real OpenAI key or a deterministic mock LLM, so we can understand every major Langf 来源：MarkTechPost

docs.text:

原文：AgentTrove is the largest open-source collection of agentic interaction traces, with 1.7M rows in a ShareGPT-style layout. docs.text:
Genesis AI Releases Nyx, Quadrants, and Genesis World 1.0 Physics Platform for Scalable Robotics Foundation Model Evaluation 摘要：Genesis AI于2026年5月27日发布了Genesis World 1.0——一个涵盖物理、渲染、编译和工具的四部分仿真平台。该系统在模拟和现实世界的机器人部署之间实现了 0.8996 的 Pearson 相关性，并将策略评估时间从超过 200 小时缩短

原文：Genesis AI released Genesis World 1.0 on May 27, 2026 — a four-component simulation platform covering physics, rendering, compilation, and tooling. The system achieves a Pearson correlation of 0.8996 between simulation and real-world robot rollouts, and reduces policy evaluation time from over 200 h 来源：MarkTechPost

docs.title: 训练与推理优化
Trajectory 发布了用于持续学习的并发多 LoRA 训练堆栈，报告实验吞吐量增益为 2.81 倍
docs.text:
Trajectory Releases a Concurrent Multi-LoRA Training Stack for Continual Learning, Reporting a 2.81× Experiment-Throughput Gain 摘要：Trajectory 与加州大学伯克利分校天空实验室和 Anyscale 合作，构建了一个并发的多 LoRA 训练堆栈，用于持续学习。它将每个 RL 实验映射到始终热引擎上的专用 LoRA 适配器，报告在 n 的单租户基线上获得了 2.81 倍的端到端实验吞吐量增益。

原文：Trajectory, working with UC Berkeley Sky Lab and Anyscale, built a concurrent multi-LoRA training stack for continual learning. It maps each RL experiment to a dedicated LoRA adapter on an always-hot engine, reporting a 2.81× end-to-end experiment-throughput gain over a single-tenant baseline with n 来源：MarkTechPost

docs.text:
Google Releases Gemini-SQL2: Gemini 3.1 Pro Text-to-SQL Scores 80.04% on BIRD Single-Model Leaderboard 摘要：我们来看看 Google Research 于 2026 年 6 月 12 日宣布的文本转 SQL 功能 Gemini-SQL2。在 Gemini 3.1 Pro 的支持下，它在 BIRD 单模型排行榜上的执行准确率达到了 80.04%。我们解释了分数的衡量标准、排行榜如何排名以及 Google 尚未披露的内容

原文：We look at Gemini-SQL2, the text-to-SQL capability Google Research announced on June 12, 2026. Powered by Gemini 3.1 Pro, it posted 80.04% execution accuracy on the BIRD single-model leaderboard. We explain what the score measures, how the leaderboard stacks up, and what Google has not yet disclosed 来源：MarkTechPost

docs.title: Moonshot AI 发布 Kimi K2.7-Code：编码模型报告 Kimi Code Bench v2 较 K2.6 提高了 21.8%
docs.text:
Moonshot AI Releases Kimi K2.7-Code: a Coding Model Reporting +21.8% on Kimi Code Bench v2 Over K2.6 摘要：Moonshot AI 在修改后的 MIT 许可证下开源了 Kimi K2.7 代码。它是一个基于 Kimi K2.6 构建的以编码为中心的代理模型，具有 256K 上下文窗口，推理令牌使用率降低了约 30%。 Moonshot 报告称，六项基准测试均超过 K2.6，其中 Kimi Code Bench v2 提高了 21.8%。这

原文：Moonshot AI has open-sourced Kimi K2.7-Code under a Modified MIT license. It is a coding-focused, agentic model built on Kimi K2.6, with a 256K context window and roughly 30% lower reasoning-token usage. Moonshot reports gains over K2.6 on six benchmarks, including +21.8% on Kimi Code Bench v2. The 来源：MarkTechPost

docs.title: Moonshot AI 推出 Kimi Work，这是一款本地桌面代理，据称运行在 Kimi K2.6 上，具有 300 个子代理代理群
docs.text:
Moonshot AI Launches Kimi Work, a Local Desktop Agent Reportedly Running on Kimi K2.6 With a 300-Sub-Agent Agent Swarm 摘要：Moonshot AI 的 Kimi Work 是适用于 macOS 和 Windows 的本地桌面代理。它运行 300 个子代理群，通过 WebBridge 驱动您登录的浏览器，并安排后台作业。 Moonshot AI 发布后推出 Kimi Work，这是一个本地桌面代理，据称运行在 Kimi K2.6 上，具有 300 个子代理

原文：Moonshot AI's Kimi Work is a local desktop agent for macOS and Windows. It runs a 300-sub-agent swarm, drives your logged-in browser via WebBridge, and schedules background jobs. The post Moonshot AI Launches Kimi Work, a Local Desktop Agent Reportedly Running on Kimi K2.6 With a 300-Sub-Agent Agent 来源：MarkTechPost

docs.title: 训练与推理优化
使用 city2graph、OSMnx 和 PyTorch Geometric 进行城市函数推理的空间图神经网络的编码实现
docs.text:
A Coding Implementation on Spatial Graph Neural Networks for Urban Function Inference Using city2graph, OSMnx, and PyTorch Geometric 摘要：我们使用 city2graph 构建端到端的空间图学习管道。我们从 OpenStreetMap 收集城市 POI 和街道网络数据，并提供综合后备以确保可靠性。我们设计空间特征，构建几个邻近图族，并比较每个图族如何代表相同的城市

原文：We build an end-to-end spatial graph learning pipeline using city2graph. We collect urban POI and street network data from OpenStreetMap, with a synthetic fallback for reliability. We engineer spatial features, construct several proximity graph families, and compare how each represents the same urba 来源：MarkTechPost

原文：In this article we look at YaFF, Yandex's open-source zero-copy wire format for the Protobuf ecosystem. We keep the .proto file as the single source of truth, changing only how data sits in memory. We walk through its four layouts — Fixed, Flat, Sparse, and Dynamic — and the benchmark where Flat Lay 来源：MarkTechPost

docs.text:
DeepReinforce Releases Ornith-1.0: An Open-Source Coding Model Family That Learns Its Own RL Scaffolds 摘要：DeepReinforce 发布了 Ornith-1.0，这是一个基于 Gemma 4 和 Qwen 3.5 构建的开源编码模型系列。该模型在强化学习过程中学习自己的支架，而不是固定的框架。 397B 旗舰版在 SWE-Bench Verified 上的得分为 82.4，所有权重均获得 MIT 许可。迪伊邮报

原文：DeepReinforce released Ornith-1.0, an open-source coding model family built on Gemma 4 and Qwen 3.5. Instead of a fixed harness, the model learns its own scaffold during reinforcement learning. The 397B flagship reports 82.4 on SWE-Bench Verified, with all weights under the MIT license. The post Dee 来源：MarkTechPost

原文：In this tutorial, we build a stable workflow around the Fable 5 Traces dataset from Hugging Face. We avoid fragile dependencies and manually parse the merged JSONL file to keep Colab reliable. We inspect repository files, normalize tool calls, audit structure, redact secrets, and visualize key distr 来源：MarkTechPost

docs.title: Liquid AI 推出 LFM2.5-230M，支持 llama.cpp、MLX、vLLM、SGLang 和 ONNX，支持设备上推理
docs.text:
Liquid AI Ships LFM2.5-230M with llama.cpp, MLX, vLLM, SGLang, and ONNX Support for On-Device Inference 摘要：Liquid AI 发布了迄今为止最小的型号 LFM2.5-230M。这个 230M 参数的开放权重模型在 Galaxy S25 Ultra 上以 213 tok/s 的速度在设备上运行，在 Raspberry Pi 5 上以 42 tok/s 的速度在设备上运行。它基于 LFM2 架构构建，以工具使用和数据提取为目标，击败了 Qwen3.5-0.8B 和 Gemma 3 1B 等较大模型

原文：Liquid AI released LFM2.5-230M, its smallest model yet. The 230M-parameter, open-weight model runs on-device at 213 tok/s on a Galaxy S25 Ultra and 42 on a Raspberry Pi 5. Built on the LFM2 architecture, it targets tool use and data extraction, beating larger models like Qwen3.5-0.8B and Gemma 3 1B 来源：MarkTechPost

docs.title: Meta 的 Astryx 将 CLI 和 MCP 服务器引入代理可以读取的开源 React 设计系统
docs.text:
Meta’s Astryx Brings a CLI and MCP Server to an Open-Source React Design System Agents Can Read 摘要：Meta 发布了 Astryx，一个基于 StyleX 构建的开源 React 设计系统。它将 CSS 变量主题级联与 CLI 和 MCP 服务器配对，因此工程师和 AI 代理都使用相同的 API 进行构建。该项目处于 Beta 阶段，已获得 MIT 许可，并在 Meta 内部发展了八年多。后 Meta 的 Astr

原文：Meta released Astryx, an open-source React design system built on StyleX. It pairs a CSS-variable theme cascade with a CLI and MCP server, so both engineers and AI agents build using the same API. The project is in Beta, MIT-licensed, and grew inside Meta over eight years. The post Meta’s Astr 来源：MarkTechPost

docs.text:
Interfaze Ships diffusion-gemma-asr-small, an Open-Source Diffusion ASR Model Transcribing Six Languages via DiffusionGemma’s Parallel Denoising Decoder 摘要：Interfaze 开源扩散-gemma-asr-small，一种通过扩散而不是自回归进行转录的多语言 ASR 模型。它使用约 42M 参数适配器将音频添加到 Google 的冻结 DiffusionGemma。一个适配器涵盖六种语言，转录成本由去噪步骤设置，而不是转录

原文：Interfaze open-sourced diffusion-gemma-asr-small, a multilingual ASR model that transcribes via diffusion, not autoregression. It adds audio to Google's frozen DiffusionGemma using a ~42M-parameter adapter. One adapter covers six languages, with transcription cost set by denoising steps, not transcr 来源：MarkTechPost

docs.title: RAG-Anything 教程：在 Colab 中构建文本、表格、方程和图像的多模态检索管道
docs.text:
RAG-Anything Tutorial: Build a Multimodal Retrieval Pipeline for Text, Tables, Equations, and Images in Colab 摘要：在本教程中，我们构建一个 RAG-Anything 工作流程来探索多模式检索如何跨文本、表格、方程和图像工作。我们准备一个 Colab 环境，在运行时输入 OpenAI API 密钥，并生成包含图表和 PDF 的综合报告。我们将该内容转换为 RAG-Anythin

原文：In this tutorial, we build a RAG-Anything workflow to explore how multimodal retrieval works across text, tables, equations, and images. docs.title: WebBrain：一个开源、本地优先的 AI 浏览器代理，可在 Chrome 和 Firefox 中读取页面并自动执行任务
docs.text:

docs.text:
NVIDIA Releases Audex (Nemotron-Labs-Audex-30B-A3B): A Unified Audio-Text LLM That Preserves the Text Intelligence of Its Backbone 摘要：NVIDIA 的 Nemotron-Labs-Audex-30B-A3B 将音频理解、语音识别、翻译、TTS 和音频生成统一在一个 MoE 模型中。它通过边际回归保留了 Nemotron-Cascade-2 主干的文本智能。 NVIDIA 发布 Audex (Nemotron-Labs-Audex-30B-A3B) 后：A U

原文：NVIDIA's Nemotron-Labs-Audex-30B-A3B unifies audio understanding, speech recognition, translation, TTS, and audio generation in one MoE model. It keeps the text intelligence of its Nemotron-Cascade-2 backbone with marginal regression. The post NVIDIA Releases Audex (Nemotron-Labs-Audex-30B-A3B): A U 来源：MarkTechPost

原文：Liquid AI released Antidoom, an open-source method that targets doom loops in reasoning models. A doom loop repeats a span until the context window is exhausted. Antidoom finds the token that starts the loop and retrains only that position using Final Token Preference Optimization (FTPO). On LFM2.5- 来源：MarkTechPost

docs.title: Netflix AI 团队通过按 ID 拆分 Cassandra 分区，将宽分区读取延迟从几秒缩短至几毫秒
docs.text:
Netflix AI Team Cuts Wide-Partition Read Latency from Seconds to Milliseconds by Splitting Cassandra Partitions Per ID 摘要：Netflix 工程师详细介绍了他们如何在 Apache Cassandra 中处理 TimeSeries 抽象的宽分区。两种方法协同工作：时间片重新分区在表级别调整未来分区，而动态分区则检测并分割每个 TimeSeries ID 上的过大分区。

原文：Netflix engineers detailed how they handle wide partitions in Apache Cassandra for the TimeSeries Abstraction. Two approaches work together: Time Slice re-partitioning tunes future partitions at the table level, while dynamic partitioning detects and splits oversized partitions per TimeSeries ID on 来源：MarkTechPost

docs.text:
Meet NeuroVFM: A New Neuroimaging Foundation Model Trained With Vol-JEPA on Uncurated Clinical MRI and CT Volumes 摘要：NeuroVFM 是来自密歇根大学的通用神经影像基础模型，经过 524 万临床 MRI 和 CT 体积的训练。其 Vol-JEPA 基础将 I-JEPA 和 V-JEPA 扩展到体积医学成像，无需放射学报告标签即可学习大脑解剖学和病理学。认识 NeuroVF 后

原文：NeuroVFM is a generalist neuroimaging foundation model from the University of Michigan, trained on 5.24M clinical MRI and CT volumes. Its Vol-JEPA base extends I-JEPA and V-JEPA to volumetric medical imaging, learning brain anatomy and pathology without radiology-report labels. The post Meet NeuroVF 来源：MarkTechPost

Meet Blume: An Open-Source, Zero-Config Documentation Framework That Ships AI-Ready Docs From a Markdown Folder 摘要：开发人员 Hayden Bleasel 发布了 Blume，这是一个获得 MIT 许可的开源文档框架。它读取 Markdown 或 MDX 文件夹并生成一个隐藏的 Astro 项目，通过本地搜索、30 多个 MDX 组件、llms.txt 和内置 MCP 服务器发送静态、AI 就绪文档。遇见布鲁姆后

原文：Developer Hayden Bleasel has released Blume, an open-source, MIT-licensed documentation framework. It reads a folder of Markdown or MDX and generates a hidden Astro project, shipping static, AI-ready docs with local search, 30+ MDX components, llms.txt, and a built-in MCP server. The post Meet Blume 来源：MarkTechPost

原文：We build a Gin Config controlled PyTorch pipeline where the training code stays fixed and the experiment variables move into .gin files. We construct a nonlinear spiral binary classification task and define a configurable MLP with scoped architectural variants. We expose the optimizer, scheduler, lo 来源：MarkTechPost

Thinking Machines Lab Releases Inkling: A 975B-Parameter Open-Weights Multimodal MoE With 41B Active Parameters And Controllable Thinking Effort 摘要：Thinking Machines Lab 于 2026 年 7 月 15 日发布了 Inkling，这是其第一个从头开始训练的模型。完整的重量在 Apache 2.0 下发布。它是一个 975B 参数的专家混合转换器，具有 41B 活动参数、1M 令牌上下文窗口以及本机文本、图像和音频输入。该实验室表示

原文：Thinking Machines Lab released Inkling on July 15, 2026, its first model trained from scratch. The full weights ship under Apache 2.0. It is a 975B-parameter Mixture-of-Experts transformer with 41B active parameters, a 1M-token context window, and native text, image, and audio input. The lab states 来源：MarkTechPost

Google Releases LiteRT.js: A JavaScript Binding of LiteRT That Runs .tflite Models in Browsers via WebGPU 摘要：Google 于 2026 年 7 月 9 日发布了 LiteRT.js。它是 Google 设备端推理库 LiteRT 的 JavaScript 绑定。运行时通过 WebAssembly 直接在浏览器中执行 .tflite 模型，在 CPU 上使用 XNNPACK，在 WebGPU 上使用 ML Drift，以及用于 NPU 的实验性 WebNN。 Google 报告高达 3 倍

原文：Google released LiteRT.js on July 9, 2026. It is a JavaScript binding of LiteRT, Google's on-device inference library. The runtime executes .tflite models directly in the browser through WebAssembly, with XNNPACK on CPU, ML Drift over WebGPU, and experimental WebNN for NPUs. Google reports up to 3x 来源：MarkTechPost

docs.text:
Moonshot AI Releases Kimi K3: A 2.8 Trillion Parameter Open MoE Model With Kimi Delta Attention and 1M Context 摘要：Moonshot AI 于 2026 年 7 月 16 日发布了 Kimi K3。它是一个基于 Kimi Delta Attention 和 Attention Residuals 构建的 2.8 万亿参数开放 MoE 模型，激活了 896 个专家中的 16 个。后登月AI发布Kimi K3：2.8万亿参数开放MoE模型，具有Kimi Delta Attention和1M Context ap

原文：Moonshot AI released Kimi K3 on July 16, 2026. It is a 2.8-trillion-parameter open MoE model built on Kimi Delta Attention and Attention Residuals, activating 16 of 896 experts. The post Moonshot AI Releases Kimi K3: A 2.8 Trillion Parameter Open MoE Model With Kimi Delta Attention and 1M Context ap 来源：MarkTechPost

docs.title: OpenAI 详细介绍了 GPT-Red：一种内部自动红队模型，在快速注入时可将人类红队成员击败 84% 至 13%
docs.text:
OpenAI Details GPT-Red: An Internal Automated Red-Teaming Model That Beat Human Red-Teamers 84% To 13% On Prompt Injection 摘要：OpenAI 训练了 GPT-Red，这是一种仅限内部的攻击者模型，使用自我对弈强化学习来对抗一群防御者 LLM。它在复制的间接即时注入竞技场上以 84% 比 13% 击败了人类红队成员，发现了一种新颖的“假思想链”攻击类别，并减少了 GPT-5.6 Sol 的失败

原文：OpenAI trained GPT-Red, an internal-only attacker model, using self-play reinforcement learning against a population of defender LLMs. It beat human red-teamers 84% to 13% on a replicated indirect prompt injection arena, found a novel "Fake Chain-of-Thought" attack class, and cut GPT-5.6 Sol's failu 来源：MarkTechPost

docs.text:
Patter SDK Guide to Building a Restaurant Booking Phone Agent with Dynamic Variables, Guardrails, Latency Dashboards, and Eval Checks 摘要：我们通过为餐厅预订用例构建语音代理工作流程来探索 Patter SDK。我们定义动态呼叫者变量，注册可调用工具以了解可用性、预订、工作时间和人员转移，并在每个回复上分层输出护栏。我们模拟语音到文本和文本到速度

原文：We explore the Patter SDK by building a voice-agent workflow for a restaurant booking use case. We define dynamic caller variables, register callable tools for availability, bookings, hours, and human transfer, and layer output guardrails over every reply. We simulate speech-to-text and text-to-spee 来源：MarkTechPost

docs.text:
Zyphra Releases ZUNA1.1: An Apache 2.0 EEG Foundation Model With Variable-Length Inputs From 0.5 To 30 Seconds 摘要：Zyphra 于 2026 年 7 月 16 日在 Apache 2.0 许可证下发布了 ZUNA1.1。 380M 掩蔽扩散自动编码器可跨任意通道布局对头皮脑电图进行重建、降噪和上采样。它接受 0.5 到 30 秒的可变长度输入，而 ZUNA1 的固定长度为 5 秒。报告的 NMSE

原文：Zyphra released ZUNA1.1 on July 16, 2026, under the Apache 2.0 license. The 380M masked diffusion autoencoder reconstructs, denoises, and upsamples scalp-EEG across arbitrary channel layouts. It accepts variable-length inputs from 0.5 to 30 seconds, against ZUNA1's fixed five seconds. Reported NMSE 来源：MarkTechPost

原文：Google Cloud's generative-ai repository ships the Always-On Memory Agent, a reference implementation that treats memory as a running process. Built on Google ADK and Gemini 3.1 Flash-Lite, it uses no vector database and no embeddings. Instead, an orchestrator routes to Ingest, Consolidate, and Query 来源：MarkTechPost

原文：A single 24GB GPU is the practical floor for serious local inference. This guide compares six open-weight models that fit one card at Q4_K_M. It covers Qwen3.6, Gemma 4, Mistral Small, gpt-oss-20b, and DeepSeek-R1-Distill. Each entry lists VRAM fit, licensing, and the job it does best. The post Best 来源：MarkTechPost

docs.title: Poolside 发布 Laguna S 2.1，这是一种开放权重代理编码模型，在 SWE-Bench 多语言上超越其权重级别
docs.text:
Poolside Releases Laguna S 2.1, an Open-Weight Agentic Coding Model Punching Above Its Weight Class on SWE-Bench Multilingual 摘要：Poolside 发布了 Laguna S 2.1，这是一个 118B 开放权重专家混合编码模型，每个代币有 8B 个活动参数和 1M 代币上下文。它在代理编码基准测试中匹配或击败了其大小数倍的模型，在 OpenMDW-1.1 下发布，并在单个 NVIDIA DGX Spark 上运行。帖子

原文：Poolside has released Laguna S 2.1, a 118B open-weight Mixture-of-Experts coding model with 8B active parameters per token and a 1M-token context. It matches or beats models several times its size on agentic coding benchmarks, ships under OpenMDW-1.1, and runs on a single NVIDIA DGX Spark. The post 来源：MarkTechPost

docs.title: Google 发布 Gemini 3.6 Flash、3.5 Flash-Lite 和 3.5 Flash Cyber​​：专为代理工作负载构建的更便宜、更高效的闪存层
docs.text:
Google Releases Gemini 3.6 Flash, 3.5 Flash-Lite, and 3.5 Flash Cyber: A Cheaper, More Token-Efficient Flash Tier Built for Agentic Workloads 摘要：Google 于 2026 年 7 月 21 日发布了 Gemini 3.6 Flash、3.5 Flash-Lite 和 3.5 Flash Cyber​​。Flash 层变得更便宜，代币效率更高，3.6 Flash 将产出代币削减 17%，并将其产出价格降至每 100 万美元 7.50 美元。 Flash-Lite 的运行速度为 350 个令牌/秒，而门控 Flash Cyber​​ 则为代码提供动力

原文：Google released Gemini 3.6 Flash, 3.5 Flash-Lite, and 3.5 Flash Cyber on July 21, 2026. The Flash tier gets cheaper and more token-efficient, with 3.6 Flash cutting output tokens 17% and dropping its output price to $7.50 per 1M. Flash-Lite runs at 350 tokens/sec, while gated Flash Cyber powers Code 来源：MarkTechPost
